title: Blow-up density lower bound for varifold tangents via Theorem 3.7 (part B: the use of 3.7 in 5.5 and 5.7)
statement: Assume DensitySemicontinuity (Simon 3.7 as frozen in the contract). Let V be an n-varifold on the open set U ⊆ ℝ^N with locally bounded first variation, x ∈ U, τ > 0, ρ^{1−n}‖δV‖(B_ρ(x)) → 0 as ρ ↓ 0 (5.1, ℝ≥0∞ form), and ρ^{-n}μ_V({y ∈ B_ρ(x) : not (Θ^n(μ_V,y) exists and ≥ τ)}) → 0 as ρ ↓ 0 (outer measure). Then for every n-varifold C on ℝ^N with IsVarifoldTangent V x C, for μ_C-a.e. y, Θ^n(μ_C, y) exists and is ≥ τ.
lean_statement: DensitySemicontinuity → ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (τ : ℝ), V.HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation → x ∈ U → 0 < τ → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ ENNReal.ofReal ρ * variationMeasure V (closedBall x ρ) / ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ n) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ V.weight {y | y ∈ closedBall x ρ ∧ ¬ ∃ θ : ℝ≥0∞, HasDensity n V.weight y θ ∧ ENNReal.ofReal τ ≤ θ} / ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ n) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → ∀ C : Varifold N n (univ : Set (Euclidean N)), IsVarifoldTangent V x C → ∀ᵐ y ∂C.weight, ∃ θ : ℝ≥0∞, HasDensity n C.weight y θ ∧ ENNReal.ofReal τ ≤ θ
